units.source_text: 他一时心迷意乱，终于不忍教三公主孤寂，决定留住。

en.t: For a time his heart was confused and unsettled, and in the end he could not bear to leave the Third Princess lonely, so he decided to stay.

units.source_text: 然而毕竟心绪不安，神思恍惚，略吃一些果物，便就寝了。

en.t: Yet after all his mind remained uneasy and distracted; he ate a little fruit and then went to bed.
